chatgptPrompt: Create a Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: two hands bending a stick of dry spaghetti into an arc at the instant before it snaps, faint ghost stamps of the pieces flying apart. Composition: the arc across the middle of the frame, hands at both ends. Lighting and treatment: soft daylight on a cream bench; a daylight lab or an everyday room, clean and exact, cream background #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, one blue #2F5BFF accent, soft strobe-ghost stamps, premium editorial science documentary look, clearly a code-rendered illustration rather than a photograph. Mood: anticipation. Text: No text. Scientific accuracy: dry spaghetti bent until it snaps usually breaks into three or more pieces because the first break sends bending waves that break it again; twisting it first can give two pieces. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph or a news image. Style: distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point and any text inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25% and the right-hand buttons.
